description: Finds deployable apps in NetActuate's marketplace (netactuate.com/marketplace): streaming servers, transcoders, WebRTC, CDN and media software that deploys on NetActuate's edge, open source and from partners such as Wowza, Broadpeak and NETINT. Filter by any mix of words, vendor, category, licensing and freeDemo; with no filter it lists them all, featured first, `limit` at a time. A vendor or category it does not know is explained in a note naming the valid ones. Each result gives the slug, name, vendor (null for open source), tagline, licensing (free, byol, trial), vpu when it needs NETINT VPU hardware, freeDemo with its terms, sizing (minimum and recommended vCPU, RAM and disk) and its URL; count is the full number of matches. Use for 'what can I deploy on NetActuate', 'is there an SRT gateway', 'which apps can I try for free' or 'what does NetActuate offer from Wowza'. One listing in full: get_marketplace_app; the vendors: list_marketplace_partners. Listings do not say where they run; for an app and a place together, use search_netactuate ('Wowza Africa').

category.description: A marketplace category: 'Media & Streaming', 'Networking & Security', 'AI & ML', 'Observability', 'Storage' or 'Consulting & Services'.

freeDemo.description: true for only the listings that offer a free live demo from their page.

licensing.description: 'free', 'byol' (bring your own license, plus NetActuate compute) or 'trial'.

limit.description: How many listings to return, 1 to 50.

query.description: Words that must all appear in the listing (name, vendor, description, features, use cases, protocols), e.g. 'transcode', 'WebRTC', 'SRT', 'ad insertion'.

vendor.description: A vendor as list_marketplace_partners names it, e.g. 'Wowza', 'NETINT', 'Broadpeak'. 'Open Source' gives the open-source projects.

name: find_marketplace_apps
title: Find apps in NetActuate's marketplace
